limitations: The 14 product tests use synthetic legal-schema sources and actual parser/runtime/source functions; they are not expert business acceptance, a new model experiment, or HTTP/UI verification.

The 7 cleanup tests directly import the actual ESM helper but replace native process APIs. No child is created and no OS signal is sent. They prove controlled call decisions, not actual kernel PGID reuse.
The nonce check and POSIX group signal are not atomic. This mitigates accidental numeric reuse; it does not establish adversarial same-UID process identity or eliminate the inspection-to-signal race.

An exited descendant that sanitizes the inherited nonce, an unreadable environment or failed inspection remains unverified and causes cleanup to fail closed; no fallback stale-PGID signal is authorized.

The lexical continuation rule is finite and heuristic: explicit source headings/names, page boundaries, tiny OCR suffixes or nearby row geometry; unknown continuity is null/uncertain, not proof that a compound word exists.
